xlsx_alias_ids.ids_written: {n} new rows got their ids in your renamed sheet; nothing else in the workbook changed.
xlsx_alias_ids.ids_open: The workbook is open in another program: the ids of {n} new rows were not written. Close it there and Sync; these rows are not created again.
xlsx_alias_ids.ids_failed: The ids of {n} new rows could not be written; the workbook was left as it was. These rows are not created again on the next Sync.
xlsx_alias_ids.unpaired: {n} new rows have no id yet; they are remembered and not created again.
xlsx_alias_ids.refused: Nothing was applied: new rows in {sheets} cannot get their ids while a renamed sheet is read. Rename the sheet back to its standard name (or remove these rows) and Sync again.
